issue_context.title: core/vm: possibly improve stack check
comments:
We will check it out.

From my experimentation in evmone:
1. For stack overflow check you only need one bit of information: "may overflow stack". This is because all instructions at most increase the stack height by 1.
2. I also check the stack height itself fist: `len(st.data) == 1024 && operation.mayOverflow`.
3. And the stack underflow is only checked if `len(st.data) != 1024`.

> For stack overflow check you only need one bit of information: "may overflow stack". This is because all instructions at most increase the stack height by 1.

Hm. Nice trick.
I'll close this, we have a PR under way
